title: 3 Quarts of Water Taking 17 Minutes To Mildly Boil Is Not What I'd Call Fast
text:
3 Quarts of Water Taking 17 Minutes To Mildly Boil Is Not What I'd Call Fast. I used a "Duxtop Whole-Clad Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Induction Ready Premium Cookware SaucePan" (so please do not reply with a comment that I need to make sure I am using the correct cookware, as you did with prior reviews).

It took 17 minutes to bring 3 quarts of water to a boil (the water started out at room temperature...I used bottled water that was at room temp to conduct my test). And it wasn't even a rolling boil at 17 minutes. It was a mild boil.

I was so disappointed at how long it took.

Either this product is underpowered, or the claims that induction cooking is so much faster than other methods are exaggerated.

Yes, I had the Gas One Induction Cooktop turned up all the way up to its highest settings regarding both temperature and power.

The Gas One is easy to operate and seems nicely built, but sadly I am sorry I bought it due to the fact it doesn't deliver the cooking speed I expected.
